alignments.note: Jehovah is the written subject of the whole verse and the ASV resumes it twice with He and he at the heads of the later cola, so every realization of that referent belongs to this noun's one discontinuous unit (rule 25), headed on the first English occurrence. The accepted alignment gave the two pronouns to the participles מַשְׁפִּיל and מְרוֹמֵם; rule 25 forbids that, since a participle in a verbless clause takes only the copula and rule 17's permission reaches a finite verb's own person and number. The competing reading marks both pronouns added under rule 20, which rule 25 excludes where the verse writes the nominal.

Participial predicate rendered by a light verb and its complement; head on low (rule 44). The subject pronoun is the written Jehovah's under rule 25.
